views.name: vw_paid_orders
views.sql: SELECT o.order_id AS order_id, o.customer_id AS customer_id, o.amount AS amount, o.discount_amount AS discount_amount, o.currency AS currency, o.created_at AS created_at FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid'

views.name: vw_order_payments
views.sql: SELECT p.order_id AS order_id, SUM(p.paid_amount) AS paid_total, SUM(p.refund_amount) AS refund_total, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments p GROUP BY p.order_id HAVING SUM(p.paid_amount) > 0

views.name: vw_order_net
views.sql: SELECT o.order_id AS order_id, o.customer_id AS customer_id, o.currency AS currency, o.amount - o.discount_amount AS net_amount, o.created_at AS created_at FROM orders o

views.name: vw_settlement
views.sql: SELECT n.order_id AS order_id, n.customer_id AS customer_id, n.currency AS currency, n.net_amount - COALESCE(p.paid_total, 0) AS open_amount, COALESCE(p.refund_total, 0) AS refund_amount, n.created_at AS created_at FROM vw_order_net n LEFT JOIN vw_order_payments p ON n.order_id = p.order_id

views.name: vw_settlement_by_customer
views.sql: SELECT s.customer_id AS customer_id, SUM(s.open_amount) AS total_open_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM vw_settlement s WHERE s.open_amount <> 0 GROUP BY s.customer_id

views.name: vw_settlement_by_region
views.sql: SELECT c.region AS region, SUM(s.open_amount) AS total_open_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS order_count FROM vw_settlement s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.region

views.name: vw_settlement_fx
views.sql: SELECT s.order_id AS order_id, f.rate AS fx_rate, s.open_amount * f.rate AS open_amount_cny FROM vw_settlement s JOIN fx_rates f ON s.currency = f.currency

views.name: vw_paid_settlement
views.sql: SELECT po.order_id AS order_id, po.amount AS amount, p.paid_total AS paid_total, po.amount - p.paid_total AS open_amount FROM vw_paid_orders po JOIN vw_order_payments p ON po.order_id = p.order_id

views.name: vw_customer_tier_summary
views.sql: SELECT c.tier AS tier, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, SUM(b.total_open_amount) AS total_open_amount FROM customers c JOIN vw_settlement_by_customer b ON c.customer_id = b.customer_id GROUP BY c.tier

views.name: vw_refund_watch
views.sql: SELECT p.order_id AS order_id, p.refund_total AS refund_total, CASE WHEN p.refund_total > 1000 THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END AS refund_level FROM vw_order_payments p
